localChanges: chore: update civ1-world, civ1-city and civ1-city-improvement

log: The capital lookup scanned the registry without a destroyed() check, so a Palace destroyed on capture counted as the capturer's (or re-taker's) capital, zeroing corruption (civ-clone/web-renderer#186). Corruption distance now uses civ1-world's civ1Distance rather than the straight-line Tile#distanceFrom (civ-clone/web-renderer#180); the far city in the corruption table moves from 28.28 to 30.

Replaces the Node 12 / yarn workflow with the standard one (Node 22, pnpm, no lock file, so it tests what a consumer resolves). Removes yarn.lock, which pinned civ1-world to a commit without lib/civ1Distance, and .yarnrc.yml. prettier:check now has --check, and the test-only import is declared.

A Created rule on Palace destroys the player's other live Palaces, so the capital moves to the new city (civ-clone/web-renderer#187). Hydrating a save doesn't run constructors, so loading is unaffected. The corruption table follows civ1-city's switch to Civ1's distance (#180).

Replaces the Node 12 / yarn workflow with the standard one (Node 22, pnpm, no lock file, so it tests what a consumer resolves). Removes yarn.lock, which pinned civ1-world to a commit without lib/civ1Distance, and .yarnrc.yml. prettier:check now has --check, and the test-only import is declared.

max(dx, dy) + floor(min(dx, dy) / 2), wrapping on x only, as v474.05's GetShortestDistance. For corruption now (civ-clone/web-renderer#180), and trade routes, incite cost and discontent later (#57, #58, #123). Tile#distanceFrom stays the engine's general straight-line measure.
Replaces the Node 12 / yarn workflow with the standard one (Node 22, pnpm, no lock file) and removes yarn.lock and .yarnrc.yml. prettier:check now has --check.
